Scope: arterial and local roads, potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, street lighting and telecom networks, sewage pump stations and storm drainage ponds for Phase 1, Part 2 of the 3rd Industrial City in Dammam.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 03-Nov-2026 data date the project is 77.6% complete against 96.6% planned, 19.0% behind plan. It gained 0.22% this week against 0.12% planned, slightly above the weekly plan but far below the rate needed to finish on time.

The P6 update now finishes the project 162 days late. The P6 update uploaded this week (data date 31-Oct-2026) schedules project finish on 27-Oct-2027, 162 days after the contract completion date of 18-May-2027, with −162 days of float; the weekly report still forecasts 18-May-2027. To finish on the contract date, the remaining 22.4% needs about 0.80% a week over the 28 whole weeks left; this week achieved 0.22%. The weakest areas remain the Zone 3 networks (67.0% against 98.2% planned), the sewage networks in Zones 1 and 3, and the road crossings.

Site photos this week

Six photo sheets uploaded with this week's report, dated 25 to 28 October 2026 by the contractor. Work centred on testing the water lines, valves and fire hydrants, a mandrel test of the telecom ducts, lift station pipework and adjusting storm water grating levels. Telecom and sewage are the largest open quantitiesNo network pipe length was added this week: telecom ducts remain 49% installed (31,233 of 64,321 m) and sewer pipes 69% (274 of 396 m). Telecom handed to the consultant rose from 6,705 m to 11,175 m; 2,184 m of potable water and 2,998 m of irrigation have also been handed over, and no sewer or storm lengths yet.

Procurement of key materials

Share of total quantity delivered to site for the long-lead items. Source: weekly presentation 03-Nov-2026, long-lead items slide.

Pumps: 2 of 15 deliveredGrundfos pump accessories are being installed at the stations, but only 2 pumps have arrived because of global shipping problems (last week's presentation said 3). The water station control panel (IGEC, 1 set) and sewage station panels (WAMCO, 4 sets) are not expected in full until January 2027; the control system target is now 28-Jan-2027.
Generators and surge vesselsThe two generators (Kohler – Abunayyan) are in the Kingdom and wait for the factory and site acceptance tests before delivery to site. Surge vessel deliveries (7) are now expected to start around 05-Nov-2026, moved from 15-Oct-2026. The VEGA supplier has given no delivery date. The water pump maintenance order (SPP) is waiting for parts.

Planned Actual

November head count is 398 (66 staff and 332 labour) against 42 planned. The plan comes from the resource-loaded P6 schedule and is far below the numbers actually on site, so it is not a useful benchmark. Labour has fallen from 397 in March–April to 332; the issue log names low manpower and productivity as a cause of delay.

Open issues and risks

IssueOwnerDetail
Pond 4ContractorMODON approved the proposal. Work starts after the sewer network at the junction of Road 25 and Road 9; new target 14-Nov-2026 (was 30-Sep-2026).
Road 25 crossingsContractorAsphalt cutting on Road 25 for the buried networks: the junction with Road 2 is done and the junction with Road 9 is in progress. Phases 1 and 2 follow once the city administration approves a traffic diversion; target 15-Nov-2026.
Permits on Roads 25 and 1Consultant / OwnerPermit issue is suspended on Roads 25 and 1 and works there are stopped. Permits were requested and submitted; awaiting approval.
Block F and Road 9Consultant / OwnerWorks in Block F stopped from 06-Oct-2026 until power is connected to the Chinese factory. Work on Road 9 in area F is banned (partial stop) despite an approved permit.
Sewer manholes and box culvertConsultant / Owner22 sewer manholes have connections that clash with the storm water box culvert, blocking pipe connections. The contractor's proposal is to be reviewed by the consultant and sent to the owner; target 05-Nov-2026.
Pump station equipmentContractorGenerators, surge vessels and pumps are paid and being manufactured; 2 sewage pumps and the fire pumps have been delivered (target 30-Nov-2026). Water pump maintenance has a purchase order; target 15-Nov-2026.
Third-party interfacesConsultant / OwnerSlab settlement caused by Watco and Al-Issa works: several meetings held, no response from Al-Issa. The Al-Issa office gate conflicts with a lighting pole foundation.
Network testingContractorTesting is needed so complete networks can be handed over. The test plan has been submitted and testing is under way.
Manpower and productivityContractorLow manpower and equipment and low productivity of the contractor's own crews (MODON issue log, high priority). Excavation is done by hand because there are no records of the existing services.

Open risks in the MODON register: change in the industrial city's priorities reducing the scope (high), delays in purchases because of regional shipping problems (high), frequent work stoppages lowering daily output (medium), and differences between the signed contract value and the work on site (medium).
